finding.headline: "Weaning the Night-Nursing Toddler After Baby"
finding.problem: "He wakes 4× crying 'boob, boob' and I give in because the baby's already awake. I'm not sleeping at all and I'm ruined."
finding.person: Mum who must night-wean her 2-year-old so she can survive newborn nights, but toddler screams for hours.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (gentle night-weaning while tandem) — pairs with A2". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
